cuts.ofreeRecent: an ancestral shrine hall with a bronze incense burner — sitting on the ground; a calligraphy classroom with low wooden desks — standing; a Guan Yu temple — standing; a sunlit white marble temple — holds her keepsake in both hands in front of her; the deck of a tall wooden sailing ship at sea — standing; a retro American diner — holds a tall iced coffee in a clear cup with a straw at chest height; a harbour quay of a port town with tall sailing ships — lying on her front; a desert oasis at golden hour — standing; a rooftop drying terrace with laundry lines overhead — turns a page of a book lying open on the table; a castle bathhouse with a stone pool — standing with one foot up on a step; an editorial photo studio with a seamless backdrop and dramatic lights — raises a camera to her eye to take a photo; a calligraphy classroom with low wooden desks — carries her keepsake low at her side; a mountain lodge with a front counter and a fireplace — holds a tall iced coffee in a clear cup with a straw at chest height
